note: Hand-labelled by one person BEFORE the judge was written, so the judge is run blind against them. SUPPORTED means a governance consultant would accept the line as relevant evidence for that question — not that it proves the question's assertion, since an evidence line's job is to frame rather than to settle.

claims.question: Board and committee packs are concise, timely and decision ready.
claims.line: The board pack comprised 247 pages across 14 papers.
claims.label: SUPPORTED

claims.question: The board has the management information it needs to hold the executive to account.

claims.question: Board members have the time available to discharge their duties properly.
claims.line: The agenda allocates 300 minutes for the meeting.
claims.label: NOT_SUPPORTED
claims.why: meeting length is not member availability; 300 minutes says nothing about whether members have time to prepare or discharge duties
